name: Decision Analysis
description: Structure complex decisions with comparable evidence, scenarios, premortems, sensitivity analysis, and review triggers.

tasks.name: Frame the decision
tasks.objective: Define owner, deadline, options, objectives, constraints, reversibility, information value, stakeholders, and what happens if no decision is made.

tasks.name: Build criteria and measures
tasks.objective: Translate objectives into measurable criteria, distinguish must-haves from tradeoffs, define uncertainty ranges, and avoid double-counting correlated criteria.

tasks.name: Collect option evidence
tasks.objective: Gather comparable evidence for each option, base rates, costs, downside exposure, opportunity cost, implementation burden, and uncertainty. Record missing evidence explicitly.

tasks.name: Model scenarios and second-order effects
tasks.objective: Test best, base, worst, and plausible regime changes; map dependencies, option value, lock-in, externalities, and effects that appear only after the first-order outcome.

tasks.name: Run premortem and adversarial review
tasks.objective: Assume each option failed. Identify mechanisms, hidden assumptions, incentive problems, tail risks, and signals that would reveal the failure early.

tasks.name: Run sensitivity analysis
tasks.objective: Vary uncertain inputs and criterion weights to identify decision pivots, robust regions, and assumptions doing most of the work.

tasks.name: Create decision record
tasks.objective: Document options, evidence, assumptions, uncertainties, irreversible commitments, monitoring triggers, and review date. Present tradeoffs rather than hiding them behind a single score.
